name: What is the difference between installing subway tile and mosaic sheet tile?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between installing subway tile and mosaic sheet tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Subway tile and mosaic sheets offer distinct trade-offs in labor, cost, and maintenance. Subway ceramic tile is classic, budget-friendly, and simple to wipe clean due to fewer grout joints, but individual piece placement requires meticulous spacing and level lines. Mosaic sheets, often made of glass or mixed stone mesh, cover surface area quickly but demand a dead-flat wall; uneven drywall can cause sheet seams to show. Additionally, mosaics feature far more grout lines, requiring more frequent cleaning and diligent sealing to prevent grease absorption behind the cooktop.
acceptedAnswer.description: Subway tile is affordable and has fewer grout lines to clean, while mosaic sheets install quickly on flat walls but require more grout maintenance and precise seam blending.
